Creative Coping: A Stress-Relief Workshop for International Students

This interactive workshop combines brief lectures, group activities, personal sharing, and creative expression using art materials to help participants strengthen their stress-management strategies.
Through these experiences, students will also explore ways to navigate emotional challenges that may arise when adjusting to a new academic and cultural environment.
Participants will engage in hands-on activities during the session, and any artworks or creative pieces they create are welcome to be taken home.
